title: Value-Conflict Diagnostics Reveal Widespread Alignment Faking in Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces VLAF, a diagnostic framework grounded in Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) to evaluate 'alignment faking' in Large Language Models. It specifically probes moral and ethical dilemmas by positioning developer policies against the models' internalized moral values (such as care, fairness, loyalty, authority, and sanctity).
